newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy mkt rate easing expectation lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy mkt rate easing expectation lower.

text.p: Italy's money market expectations for an interest rate cut are lower than a week ago, a study based on implicit forward rates conducted by the Bocconi University research arm Igier shows.

In one month's time the implicit overnight rate is seen at 8.22 percent from an actual market rate of 8.44 percent on Thursday, the day on which Igier based its study. Italy's official discount rate stands at 8.25 percent.
A week ago the implicit overnight rate on the same time horizon was seen standing at 8.11 percent, while three months ago it was seen standing at 8.31 percent.

On a three month timeframe, the implicit overnight rate is seen standing at 7.88 percent, from 7.69 percent forecast a week ago. In one year's time, the implicit overnight rate is seen standing at 7.19 percent from 7.03 percent seen a week ago.
In two year's time, the implicit overnight rate is seen standing at 7.41 percent, from 7.43 percent seen last week.

The spread between the implicit overnight rate and the implicit German overnight rate, considered a good indicator of market confidence in Europe's Economic and Monetary Union, is seen falling to 257 basis points from 266 basis points seen last week and 312 basis points forecast a month ago.
